blocks.tamil_translation: from it. In the same way, I too keep holding you by your waists and saving you from the fire of Hell. But you slip away from my hand” (and are about to fall into the fire of Hell). Hazrat Jabir (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- In this most excellent hadith, the boundless love of the Prophet ﷺ for this Ummah and his intense longing to save his Ummah from the fire of Hell are described.
(Nawawi)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵁ قَالَ: كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَي النَّبِيِّ ﷺ يَحْكِي نَبِيّاً مِنَ اْلاَنْبِيَاءِ ضَرَبَهُ قَوْمُهُ فَأَدْمَوْهُ وَهُوَ يَمْسَحُ الدَّمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ وَيَقُولُ: اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِقَوْمِي فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، كتاب احاديث الانبياء، رقم:٣٤٧٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah (RA) narrates, “The Ummah of a Prophet beat him again and again until he was covered in blood. That Prophet (AS), wiping the blood from his face, said, “O Allah, forgive my people, for they do not know.” It is as if I am still watching the Prophet ﷺ describing the incident of that Prophet (AS).

blocks.text: (A similar incident happened to the Prophet ﷺ as well in the Battle of Uhud).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ هِنْدِ بْنِ أَبِي هَالَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ مُتَوَاصِلَ اْلاَحْزَانِ دَائِمَ الْفِكْرَةِ لَيْسَتْ لَهُ رَاحَةٌ طَوِيلَ السَّكْتِ لَا يَتَكَلَّمُ فِي غَيْرِ حَاجَةٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو طرف من الرواية) الشمائل المحمدية والخصائل المصطفوية، رقم:٢٢٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “The Prophet ﷺ was continuously grieved (about his Ummah) and always worried
